description: Load the steps from a recording session (the journal on the connected agent) into a new AUTOMATION draft. Use this to save a recording that finished — including one from an earlier session. Then review with tc_draft_get and persist with tc_save. If the recording targeted an existing TC, pass its id via `tcId` so the draft inherits title/module/project and tc_save UPDATES that TC instead of creating a new one. Requires a live connection (qa_connect) with an agent that owns the recording journal.

sessionId.description: The recording session id — the same id used when the recording started.

tcId.description: Optional: an existing TC id to inherit title/module/project from (and to UPDATE on save).

title.description: Optional draft title (overrides tcId meta). Defaults to "Recording <sessionId>" when no tcId is passed.

name: tc_draft_from_journal
title: Load a recording journal as an automation draft
